d:
90 ke dashak ki suparhit romantik philm sapne sajan ke ke is sanpurn sanklan ke sath bolivud ke sunahre daur ko phir se jien. dipak aur jyoti ki khubsurat prem kahani dekhen, jo kismat, galatphahmiyon aur bhavnatmak moron se gujarti hai. sadabhar sangit aur yadgar abhinay se saji ek avismarniy prem katha.
MOVIE : Sapne Saajan Ke (1992)
Cast : Rahul Roy, Karisma Kapoor, Jackie Shroff, Dimple Kapadia, Gulshan Grover, Aruna Irani, Alok Nath, Reema Lagoo, Shakti Kapoor
Directed by: Lawrence D'Souza
Produced by: Sudhakar Bokade
Written by: Anwar Khan, Lawrence D'Souza
Music by: Nadeem–Shravan
